summary: Iteration 5 Part 1 (Welcome/Sign-in/Register/Verify-email/Navigation) verified end-to-end. Backend: 102/102 pytest PASS (85 prior regression + 17 new iter5 in test_iteration5.py). All spec items verified: (1) POST /auth/register with accept_terms=true stores email_verified=false + terms_accepted_at ISO timestamp (verified via direct Mongo read); with accept_terms=false terms_accepted_at is null; still returns TokenOut. (2) POST /auth/send-verification returns dev_code (6-digit numeric) + resend_after_sec=45 + delivered_via_email=false when SENDGRID_API_KEY unset; second immediate call returns 429 with 'wait Ns' detail (cooldown honored). (3) POST /auth/verify-email with wrong code -> 400 'Incorrect code — please double-check and try again.'; correct code -> {ok:true, email_verified:true} and /auth/me now shows email_verified=true; expired code (backdated via Mongo) -> 400 with 'expired' in detail; non-numeric/short code -> 400. (4) POST /auth/change-email lowercases new email, invalidates prior codes (subsequent verify -> 400 'No active verification code'), sets email_verified=false, updates users.email. (5) POST /customers/me/profile stores country+city+profile_completed=true; hairdressers -> 403. (6) POST /hairdressers/me/basics stores country/service_area/salon_name/bio and updates user.name when display_name provided; customers -> 403. (7) Regression: sara/amara/admin login all 200 with email_verified=true (backfill confirmed). All existing bookings/subscriptions/admin/google/hairstyles endpoints still pass (73 regression tests all green). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): /welcome renders hero + 'How do you want to start?' + lang-picker (English · Français coming soon) + explain paragraph + welcome-customer + welcome-braider + welcome-existing + welcome-google. Demo credentials NOT visible on /welcome or /login. /login: login-email starts empty (no pre-fill), login-toggle-pw eye works, forgot-password reveals forgot-msg 'coming soon' copy, go-register routes to /welcome (Path C ✓). Customer register (/register?role=customer) has NO reg-phone field, has register-back arrow, terms checkbox, submit routes to /verify-email (Path A ✓). Braider register (/register?role=hairdresser) shows reg-phone with privacy note (Path B form ✓). /verify-email shows 6 digit boxes (digit-0..5), dev-code-banner with actual 6-digit code (extracted '091556' in this run), wrong code -> verify-err 'Incorrect code — please double-check and try again.', correct code -> routes customer to /customer/profile (cp-country/cp-city). Resend countdown 'Resend in 44s' visible after send. Note: MOCKED SendGrid — dev_code exposed in banner (working as designed).

ui_bugs.issue: When user is already email_verified and re-visits /verify-email, backend returns {already_verified: true} (no 'email' field) but frontend still shows `Code sent to ${r.email}` -> renders 'Code sent to undefined'. Also sets cooldown to 45 unnecessarily. Should early-return / navigate away instead. Reference: /app/frontend/app/verify-email.tsx:24-35.

action_items: LOW: In /app/frontend/app/verify-email.tsx sendCode(), if response.already_verified === true, skip setting info/cooldown and router.replace to the correct next screen (customer -> /customer/profile if no country, else /(tabs)/home; hairdresser -> /pro/onboarding). Fixes 'Code sent to undefined' cosmetic bug when returning to /verify-email after verification.
LOW: Consider surfacing dev_code copy affordance (tap-to-copy) in dev-code-banner to speed up manual QA. Current copy is fine but not selectable easily on mobile web.
INFO: /welcome lang-picker (globe pill) is a no-op — that's OK per spec ('language selector placeholder').
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:280 stores terms_accepted_at only when accept_terms=true, null otherwise — matches spec.
server.py:339-355 _send_verification_email correctly falls back to dev-mode log + returns False when SENDGRID_KEY empty; caller adds dev_code to response only when delivered==False. Clean.
server.py:363-368 resend cooldown reads most-recent code by created_at DESC — correct. Elapsed math uses timezone-aware datetimes consistently.

server.py:391-403 verify-email guards order is correct: format -> active-code exists -> expiry -> match. Only mutates users.email_verified on match. Attempts counter increments on wrong code (good for future rate-limiting).

server.py:407-414 change-email lowercases new email, checks collision (excludes self), invalidates codes via consumed=true. However it does NOT auto-send a new code — frontend re-triggers send-verification in the finally branch of changeEmail(). Works, but a nicer server-side behavior would be to auto-generate a fresh code on change and return it. Minor.
server.py:430-440 pro-basics also mirrors service_area into 'city' on the hairdresser doc (see line 434) — this is by design since service_area is the public-facing city. Confirmed.
Frontend /register.tsx correctly gates submit with (!isPro || phone.trim().length >= 4) — phone required only for pros.
verify-email.tsx setCooldown default of 45 when server omits resend_after_sec is safe fallback but hides the already_verified case — see action item above.

Path H (Sign Out -> /welcome) not directly tested in this run but Sign Out handlers on customer profile/pro dashboard/admin were unchanged from iter4 which was verified. No code change to signOut path in iter5.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend/tests && python -m pytest -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml (102 tests, ~42s). Iter5 endpoints: POST /auth/register (accept_terms bool, phone optional, sets email_verified=false + terms_accepted_at); POST /auth/send-verification (auth required, returns dev_code+resend_after_sec=45 in dev mode, 429 on rapid retry); POST /auth/verify-email {code:'6digits'} (400 for wrong/expired/short); POST /auth/change-email {new_email} (lowercases, invalidates codes, resets email_verified); POST /customers/me/profile {country,city} (customers only); POST /hairdressers/me/basics {display_name?,country,service_area,salon_name?,bio?} (pros only, updates users.name if display_name given). Frontend testIDs: welcome-{customer,braider,existing,google}, lang-picker, register-back, reg-{name,email,password,confirm,phone,toggle-pw,accept,submit,error}, verify-{back,submit,resend,err}, dev-code-banner, digit-0..5, change-email-{open,input,save,cancel}, cp-{back,country,city,submit,err}. Path routing: Register->/verify-email; verify (customer)->/customer/profile->/(tabs)/home; verify (hairdresser)->/pro/onboarding->/pro/dashboard. Login (sara)->/(tabs)/home direct (email_verified=true+customer). SENDGRID_API_KEY intentionally unset — dev_code banner is expected UX. Do NOT flag the yellow dev-mode banner as a bug — it's spec.
rca_of_issue: 'Code sent to undefined' bug: /app/frontend/app/verify-email.tsx line 27-29 `setInfo(\`Code sent to ${r.email}\`)` — when backend early-returns `{already_verified: true}` (server.py:361-362) the `r.email` is undefined, template literal renders 'undefined'. Reproduction: 1) Register a fresh customer, 2) enter correct dev_code and complete verification, 3) manually navigate back to /verify-email (or refresh) -> banner shows 'Code sent to undefined' and idle Resend countdown. Mitigation: guard `if (r.already_verified) { router.replace(...) ; return; }` at the top of sendCode() before setting info/cooldown. Single-line fix, safe.
